cases.title: Mounted pony cannot push a boulder into a solid wall
cases.mission: hack.c:cannot_push_msg mounted branch through moverock_core obstructed-destination caller
cases.sourceTrace: A mounted lawful Knight moves a boulder into the west room wall. C moverock_core takes the obstructed-destination else and invokes cannot_push_msg, which names the pony. JS records the void-callee gap instead; the helper itself also lacks mounted behavior. Worker summary line 2519 denotes the parallel closed-door caller, corrected here to actual obstructed-destination caller line 2444.

cases.title: Dipping worn slippery gloves in a fountain washes hands
sourcePointers: nethack-c/upstream/src/fountain.c:447-454 dipfountain worn-glove branch and ER_GREASED test
cases.sourceTrace: C compares the selected object with canonical uarmg and washes gloved hands, clearing Glib before water_damage and the ER_GREASED rn2(2) gate. JS compares against state.u.uarmg while its worn-glove owner is state.uarmg, skips wash_hands, and goes to ordinary fountain fate. This pointer comparison is the first mismatching behavior.

cases.title: An ordinary item can be dropped and recovered on a fountain
cases.mission: do.c:drop -> dropx -> dropy/dropz -> flooreffects ordinary FOUNTAIN placement
cases.sourceTrace: C drops a carried ordinary potion onto a wished fountain, retains the object and allows it to be picked back up. FOUNTAIN is dry ordinary placement for flooreffects. JS dropx preflight rejects the terrain before execution because FOUNTAIN is missing from its ordinary allowlist; later distfleeck RNG is absent because the drop turn never runs.
